subject: Recap + next steps: ClearSight privacy & retention carveout
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lopez <emma.lopez@clearsight.ai>, Jonathan Park <jonathan@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + next steps: ClearSight privacy & retention carveout

Thanks for the call today — quick recap and pragmatic next steps so we keep momentum. Great to meet Emma and Jonathan.

Call highlights
- ClearSight needs stronger controls around PII and short retention for inference logs (sensitivity: PHI + identifiers).
- Primary asks: 0-retention for explicitly identified PII fields, shortened ephemeral logs for telemetry/KV, and US-only residency for customer data.
- Legal will send DPA redlines; Security wants SOC2 evidence and a technical runbook for deletion proofs.

Open clarifying questions for you (helps us scope the minimal exception):
1) Can you publish a short list of the PII fields you insist on 0-retention for (e.g., SSN, MRN, patient name + DOB)?
2) Does ClearSight require 0-retention for all prompt text, or only for fields containing identifiers (we heard the latter but want confirmation)?
3) Do you have a maximum acceptable ephemeral window for non-PII telemetry (7 days, 14 days, or otherwise)?

Proposed Redwood approach (for discussion)
- Option A (hosted, lower uplift): redact/normalize designated PII at ingress + 7-day ephemeral logs for telemetry.
- Option B (dedicated/private with stricter SLA): engineered 0-retention for marked PII, full US-only residency, and deletion proof logs — higher committed cost.

Attachments: retention_policy_matrix.xlsx (matrix mapping field -> suggested retention/controls).

Next steps
- Emma/Jonathan: confirm PII field list and acceptable ephemeral window by EOD Fri.
- Redwood: scoped feasibility + cost delta (send by Mon 3/16).
- Schedule 30-min technical follow-up to finalize enforcement approach.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Emma Lopez <emma.lopez@clearsight.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonathan Park <jonathan@clearsight.ai>, ClearSight Legal <legal@clearsight.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: ClearSight privacy & retention carveout

Thanks Vivek — quick answers below and a few asks from our side.

PII scope (must be 0-retention):
- Patient identifier (full name + DOB)
- Medical record number (MRN)
- SSN / government IDs
- Any free-text field that contains the above (we'd expect redaction)

Non-PII telemetry: acceptable up to 14 days for debugging/observability, provided KV caches do not retain decrypted prompt text and are rotated.

Residency: US-only required (data in transit across regions OK for control plane, but inference and logs must remain in US regions).

Legal asks: we'll send redlines to the DPA (targeting retention clauses + deletion proof). Also need SOC2 Type II report and a brief description of your key rotation/KMS approach.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can produce a signed statement that fields marked as 0-retention are purged immediately and not present in any backups? If not immediate, what is the exact window?

Proposed timeline: we need a viability note and cost delta by Mon 3/16 to present at our PM review on Tue 3/17.

- Emma
Senior Product Manager, ClearSight Analytics
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lopez <emma.lopez@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Jonathan Park <jonathan@clearsight.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: ClearSight privacy & retention carveout

On Fri, Mar 13, 2026 at 09:04 AM Emma Lopez <emma.lopez@clearsight.ai> wrote:
> Can you confirm whether Redwood can produce a signed statement that fields marked as 0-retention are purged immediately and not present in any backups?

Internal note for Marissa & Aditya — copying Jonathan/Emma for transparency:
- Security/Product follow-up: we can offer two pragmatic paths.
  * Path 1 (fast): hosted with redaction pipeline + 7-day ephemeral logs. Minimal effort, small cost uplift (~10-15%). No backup exposure for redacted fields; we still retain anonymized aggregates.
  * Path 2 (compliance-grade): dedicated deployment (customer-dedicated capacity or private) with engineered 0-retention for flagged fields, deletion proofs, and documented backup exclusion. This requires a small infra change and contractual SLA; estimated uplift ~20-30% and commitment term.

Attached: redlined_DPA.pdf (first pass) and an excerpt from our technical runbook (technical_runbook_excerpt.txt) showing deletion workflows and KMS notes.

Action items for Redwood (Vivek/Marissa/Aditya):
- Prepare a short tech note (feasibility + exact deletion windows + cost delta) by EOD today.
- Security to pull SOC2 Type II attestation and a short KMS rotation summary for ClearSight.

Marissa: can you draft the two-path pricing bullet (quick comparison) so we can present to Emma/Jonathan?

Vivek
From: Jonathan Park <jonathan@clearsight.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Emma Lopez <emma.lopez@clearsight.ai>
Cc: ClearSight Legal <legal@clearsight.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 12:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: ClearSight privacy & retention carveout

Thanks — a few procurement/legal clarifications from our side:
- DPA redlines: we'll push for explicit deletion proofs and a clause that Redwood will not store 0-retention fields in backups. If you can provide a short operational runbook excerpt (steps + logs we would receive as proof), that will accelerate sign-off.
- KMS: need to confirm whether customer-managed keys (CMK) is an option for this deployment (preferred).
- SOC2: our security team requires the latest SOC2 Type II and a recent vulnerability scan summary.
- SLA exception: we will request an addendum that states deletion confirmation within X hours for PII removal — we realize this is negotiable but need something explicit.

Would be helpful if Redwood security could join a 30-min technical sync on Thu 3/18 to walk our engineers through the deletion flow.

-Jonathan
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lopez <emma.lopez@clearsight.ai>, Jonathan Park <jonathan@clearsight.ai>, ClearSight Legal <legal@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 15:31:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: ClearSight privacy & retention carveout — next steps and meeting

Appreciate the clarity — final short recap and agreed next steps:

Agreed next steps (owners & dates)
1) Redwood: technical feasibility note + two-path pricing (Path 1 hosted redaction + 7d logs; Path 2 dedicated 0-retention for flagged fields) — due Tue 3/16 EOD (owner: Marissa).
2) Redwood Security: SOC2 Type II attestation + KMS summary + runbook excerpt (owner: Aditya) — due Wed 3/17 EOD.
3) ClearSight Legal: send DPA redlines (we received an initial PDF; please confirm final redlines) — target Wed 3/17.
4) Schedule 30-min technical sync with Redwood Security & ClearSight engineers — Thu 3/18 at 10:00 AM PT (tentative; calendar invite to follow).

Attachments included in this thread: retention_policy_matrix.xlsx, redlined_DPA.pdf, technical_runbook_excerpt.txt.

If that aligns, I will (a) send a short summary to our internal Product and Security teams, (b) post the HubSpot note linking to ClearSight PRD (HubSpot: CS-2026-041), and (c) draft the meeting invite.

Thanks again — looking forward to the sync.

Best,
Vivek
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
